VHF 频差通常 0.6 MHz，UHF 通常 5 MHz。: The VHF offset is usually 0.6 MHz and the UHF offset usually 5 MHz.
上台先报呼号，通联简短，留出间隔让其他台插入。: Give your callsign first, keep contacts short and leave gaps so other stations can break in.
中继台上下行异频：上行是你的发射频率，下行是收听频率，二者之差为频差。: A repeater uses different frequencies for up and down: the uplink is your transmit frequency and the downlink the one you listen on; the difference between them is the offset.
多数中继台发射时需加亚音（CTCSS），否则无法打开中继。: Most repeaters need a sub-audible tone (CTCSS) when transmitting, otherwise the repeater will not open.
天线应远离架空电力线，防止触电与感应雷击。: Antennas should be kept away from overhead power lines to prevent electric shock and induced lightning strikes.
对方 QTH、设备、姓名等: The other station's QTH, equipment, name, etc.
对方回应后，报双方呼号并给出信号报告（如 59）。: Once the other station replies, give both callsigns and a signal report (e.g. 59).
日期、时间、频率、模式、信号报告: Date, time, frequency, mode, signal report
本台呼号与对方呼号: Your own callsign and the other station's
本次通联所用频率: The frequency used for this contact
电台、馈线与天线的良好接地是防雷与安全的基础。: Good grounding of the radio, feedline and antenna is the basis of lightning protection and safety.
简短交换姓名、QTH 位置、设备等信息。: Briefly exchange name, QTH (location), equipment and similar information.
致 73，再次报双方呼号，结束并转入守听。: Send 73, give both callsigns again, close and return to listening.
雷电天气应断开天线与电源，切勿操作电台。: In thundery weather disconnect the antenna and the power supply, and never operate the radio.
馈线进入室内前应加装避雷器并就近接地。: Fit an arrester before the feedline enters the building and ground it nearby.
